ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized in discrete spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs are clustered at the distal tips of both lobes. A sparse distribution of roughly circular white focal spots is mapped across the medial and central regions of both dark-pigmented lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 85-95 degrees relative to the lobe base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular jagged serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes (high-frequency) along the entire trailing edge; several distinct macro-indentations are visible on the distal-lateral edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward sweeps.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) distributed across the ventral surface, with high density at the lobe tips, corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions are visible, notably a near-horizontal mark in the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and ragged tissue loss on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'constellation' pattern of high-contrast white spots against a uniform black background.
